title: Search that stays fast on long histories
items: Searching a large endpoint answers within a couple of seconds: it reads the newest requests first, shows how far back it has searched, and Search older in the dashboard continues from there

The search API returns X-Search-Complete, X-Search-Searched-Until and X-Search-Cursor headers, and takes cursor to read on from where a page stopped; send paged=true to get each page within about 2 seconds, and following a search to its end has its own rate limit
Search finds emails by their subject, text and sender and recipient addresses, also when the message was sent as base64 or quoted-printable
Searching for a request id finds that request first
% and _ in a search are now found as written instead of matching any text
from and to accept durations such as 1h or 7d, so whk requests search --from 1h works
A count without a search term or method is exact, for one endpoint or all of them; a count with one says whether it is exact, and counts on with a cursor when it is not
An account runs up to 2 searches at once; more are asked to retry shortly (429 search_busy), and a search term is at most 1,000 characters
